_comment: As-PAID figures taken from the MSC forum settlement summaries. These are NOT auto-derivable; refresh by fetching each URL below and updating mint / subproxy. mint=null means the prime had no mint-debt allocator that month; a missing prime/month means it was not settled that month. GAR and CP are NOT per-forum-entry fields: GAR is computed from the top-level 'gar' config block (rate x base + backlog true-up), CP from the 'cp' block.
_supply_side_comment: First month the settlement minted (and paid the prime) its SUPPLY-SIDE revenue share (SV). Before this, only the demand side was settled, so mint == sky_revenue. From this month, mint == sky_revenue + SV, where SV = profit - agent_rate - DR (prime_agent_profit now INCLUDES DR, so DR is subtracted out — both AR and DR are demand-side, not minted). Used by §3.
raw_endpoint_hint: Discourse raw text is at https://forum.skyeco.com/raw/<topic_id>/<post_number> (e.g. /raw/27962/3). Prefer the raw endpoint to verify exact figures.
_demand_side_comment: Per-prime 'Demand Side Total' (Distribution Rewards + SSR/agent-rate on subproxy treasury) from each MSC thread's detailed OP (post #1). Pre-May (MSC#5-#8) the Demand Side Total equals the SubProxy, since only the demand side was paid out then; Apr values are the SubProxy (OP detail not itemized that month). From MSC#9 (May) the SubProxy adds supply-side revenue (+ GAR for Skybase), so DST < SubProxy. Skybase DST EXCLUDES GAR (GAR is a separate SubProxy component).
_gar_comment: GAR (Governance Accessibility Rewards) = rate × base, monthly. Only Skybase earns it. GAR began being SETTLED in settle_from (2026-05): from that month, the month's own GAR is bundled into the Demand Side Total / SubProxy, AND a one-time true-up for the accrued backlog over trueup_period (2025-05..2026-04) was paid in trueup_paid_month (2026-05). base is the monthly metric GAR is 1% of (verified: 1% × Σ base over trueup_period = 1,383,235 = the stated true-up).
_cp_comment: Chronicle Points (CP) = 20% of base rate (SSR+0.30%) on the Chronicle Farm USDS balance (Dune query 7696411). Only Grove. Paid Surplus Buffer → SubProxy (part of demand side, DV). MSC#8 (2026-04 settlement) paid the backlog Jul-2025→Mar-2026 (144412.94+19323.86+19170.72=182907.52); MSC#9 (2026-05) paid Apr+May (17001.13+18585.45=35586.58). 'subproxy' = CP included in that settlement month's SubProxy. Reconciles to 0 (we add the same amount we paid).
